pr_title: sql: code generation for missing pg_catalog columns
pr_body:
Previously, keeping up with postgres by adding the same columns in pg_catalog
was a manual process
This was inadequate because from version to version the list of missing
columns might increase a lot
To address this, this patch closes the gap between postgres and cockroachdb
by adding the missing columns automatically with nil values

Release note: None

Fixes: #58001

issue_context.title: sql: create empty pg_catalog tables that are missing
issue_context.body: @mnovelodou recently created a test that shows which pg_catalog tables are missing. These tables should be created. Ideally, there would be a way to do this automatically, and not by manually typing out each table definition.

review_comments: Can you add some comments explaining what is happening here, it's hard to follow and comments / guidance would definitely lessen the cognitive load for the next person to understand
Can you add a comment on what this function is used for?
Can we handle the case where the column cannot be NULL?

We already discussed this with @rafiss, we are doing as much as we can to improve compatibility, but addressing columns as not null will implicate to define a Zero value for that column that is interpreted as a zero value and not the actual value. That is the reason we are not even adding NOT NULL columns to the create tables.

I think the only way to add a NOT NULL column is to do it manually by implementing the column.
Add explanation for what this function does
